afterimage_shiro.name: Shiro — The Man Between Frames
afterimage_shiro.rules: Between Frames — Once per turn, after one of your Afterimage monsters changes stance, you may Shift that monster. Manifest — 9 Mana: Place Shiro into an empty Monster Slot in Attack Stance. Leader Permadeath: if Shiro is destroyed after Manifesting, he is permanently removed from the game. Empty Frame — When Shiro Manifests, choose one Afterimage monster you control. Shift it up to two slots, then change its stance. Frame Zero — Activate 5: Once per turn, choose one Afterimage monster you control. Change its stance. Then it may immediately attack an opposing monster. If that attack Breaks the target, Shift the attacking monster after the battle.

afterimage_kage.name: Afterimage — Kage, Crossing Blade
afterimage_kage.rules: Vanishing Step — Once per turn, after this monster changes from Attack Stance to Defense Stance, you may Shift it. If you do, choose one opposing monster adjacent to its new slot. It gets -500 to its current combat value until end of turn. Phantom Cut — Activate 2: Change Kage from Defense Stance to Attack Stance. If you do, Kage may attack a monster this turn even if he has already attacked. He cannot attack Life again this turn.

afterimage_mika.name: Afterimage — Mika, Paper Witch
afterimage_mika.rules: Paper Barrier — While this monster is in Defense Stance, adjacent Afterimage monsters gain +400 DEF. Fold the Seal — Activate 2: Choose another Afterimage monster you control. Change it to Defense Stance. If that monster was already in Defense Stance, instead give it +500 DEF until end of turn. Once per turn.

afterimage_rin.name: Afterimage — Rin, Headless Rider
afterimage_rin.rules: Headlong — When this monster attacks an opposing monster, it gains +400 ATK for that battle if that monster is in Defense Stance. Momentum — Once per turn, when this monster Breaks an opposing monster, ready this monster into Attack Stance. It may attack again this turn, but its next attack cannot target Life.

afterimage_dont_look_back.name: Don't Look Back
afterimage_dont_look_back.rules: Activate during either player's turn when an Afterimage monster you control becomes the target of an attack. Change that monster's stance. The battle then uses its new current combat value. After the battle, if that monster was not Broken, Shift it. Pay the cost by tapping 3 ready Mana, or Burn 3 already-tapped Mana by returning them to the Mana Deck.

afterimage_death_has_bad_timing.name: Death Has Bad Timing
afterimage_death_has_bad_timing.rules: Activate during either player's turn when an Afterimage monster you control would be Broken by an attack. Change that monster's stance, then recalculate the battle using its new current combat value. If the attacking monster no longer exceeds that value, prevent the Break. Then tap the attacking monster if it is not already tapped. Pay the cost by tapping 4 ready Mana, or Burn 4 already-tapped Mana by returning them to the Mana Deck.

afterimage_yurei.name: Afterimage — Yurei, Lantern Keeper
afterimage_yurei.rules: Lingering Light — Once per turn, after another Afterimage monster you control Shifts, you may change Yurei's stance. Follow the Lantern — Activate 2: Choose another Afterimage monster you control. Shift it one slot. If it moved adjacent to Yurei, it gets +300 to its current combat value until end of turn.

afterimage_sora.name: Afterimage — Sora, Severed Thread
afterimage_sora.rules: Wrong Place — Once per turn, after Sora Shifts, choose one opposing monster adjacent to his new slot. That monster gets -400 to its current combat value until end of turn. Severed Thread — Activate 3: Change Sora's stance. Then Shift him one slot. If he becomes adjacent to an opposing monster he was not adjacent to before, he gets +500 ATK until end of turn.

afterimage_the_space_between_footsteps.name: The Space Between Footsteps
afterimage_the_space_between_footsteps.rules: Choose up to three Afterimage monsters you control. You may Shift each chosen monster once, in any order. Then you may change the stance of one of those monsters. Monsters moved by this effect cannot attack Life this turn.

afterimage_everyone_remembers_you_wrong.name: Everyone Remembers You Wrong
afterimage_everyone_remembers_you_wrong.rules: Choose one Afterimage monster in your Discard with cost 4 or less. Place it into an empty Monster Slot in Defense Stance. It cannot change to Attack Stance this turn. At the end of your next turn, if that monster is still on the field, return it to your hand.

not_so_fast.name: Not So Fast.
not_so_fast.rules: When an opposing monster declares an attack: You may reveal this card from your hand. Tap 2 Mana. Change the attacking monster to Defense Stance. The attack ends. Then discard this card.

i_saw_that_coming.name: I Saw That Coming.
i_saw_that_coming.rules: When your opponent activates a monster's activated effect: You may reveal this card from your hand. Tap 2 Mana. Increase that effect's activation cost by 2 Mana. Your opponent may pay the additional cost. If they do not, that effect ends. Then discard this card.

name.name: You're Not Getting Away That Easy

youre_not_getting_away_that_easy.name: You're Not Getting Away That Easy
youre_not_getting_away_that_easy.rules: Choose one monster in either player's Discard with cost 4 or less. Return it to its owner's hand. If that monster was Broken before being destroyed, its owner draws 1 card, then discards 1 card.

wrong_place_wrong_time.name: Wrong Place, Wrong Time
wrong_place_wrong_time.rules: Choose one opposing monster. Move it to another empty Monster Slot. Then choose one: Change its stance; or it gets -700 to its current combat value until end of turn. A monster moved by this effect cannot attack Life this turn.

name.name: Afterimage — Noa, Blade in the Dead Angle

afterimage_noa.name: Afterimage — Noa, Blade in the Dead Angle
afterimage_noa.rules: A Thousand Angles — Activate 2: Once per turn, choose one: Feint — Change Noa's stance. Then choose one opposing monster and change its stance. Intercept — Until the beginning of your next turn, Noa gains +600 DEF. The next time an adjacent Afterimage monster would be attacked, you may make Noa the attack target instead. Opening — Noa gains +600 ATK until end of turn. If she attacks a monster this turn, that monster cannot change its stance during that battle. Never the Same Angle Twice — You cannot choose the same A Thousand Angles option on consecutive turns.
